description: Expert-validated betting markets for calibrating LLM critic
notes: Scores estimated based on betting domain knowledge. In production these would come from experienced trader sessions.

markets.market_name: Will there be a red card?
markets.description: Will any player be sent off during the match?
markets.expert_reasoning: Clear settlement from official data. Exciting for fans. Hard to exploit.

markets.description: Which player performs the most creative goal celebration?
markets.expert_reasoning: Completely subjective. Cannot be settled objectively. Never offer this type of market.

markets.description: Will either team score within the first 10 minutes?
markets.expert_reasoning: Perfect market. Clear settlement. Very exciting. Low exploit risk.

markets.description: Will both teams score at least one goal each?
markets.expert_reasoning: Classic popular market. Clear settlement. Manageable risk.

markets.description: What nationality is the match referee?
markets.expert_reasoning: Settleable but zero fun. Nobody bets on this. Waste of market slot.

markets.description: Will the match be level after 90 minutes requiring extra time?
markets.expert_reasoning: Clear settlement. Exciting prospect. Low exploit risk.

markets.description: Will there be 10 or more corners in the match?
markets.expert_reasoning: Settleable but moderate fun and exploit risk. Trader should review pricing carefully.

markets.description: Will the starting goalkeeper make 5 or more saves during the match?
markets.expert_reasoning: Clear from official match stats. Exciting for fans who follow goalkeepers. Rewards good shot stopping.

markets.description: Will either team keep a clean sheet and concede no goals?
markets.expert_reasoning: Very clear settlement. Popular market. Goalkeeper heroics make it exciting. Low exploit risk.

markets.description: Will the match go to a penalty shootout after extra time?
markets.expert_reasoning: Most dramatic World Cup market. Crystal clear settlement. Very low exploit risk. Maximum fan excitement.

markets.description: Will either goalkeeper save a penalty during normal time or extra time?
markets.expert_reasoning: Dramatic moment. Clear settlement. Hard to exploit. Martinez and Livakovic both known penalty specialists — very relevant signal.

markets.market_name: Goalkeeper Named Player Of The Match
markets.description: Will a goalkeeper win the official player of the match award?
markets.expert_reasoning: Settleable from official award. Fun narrative around goalkeeper heroics. Moderate confidence — depends on match context.

markets.description: Will the goalkeeper with the most saves in the match make 4 or more saves?
markets.expert_reasoning: Settleable from official data. Moderate fan appeal. Depends on match being one-sided. Trader should check data provider.

markets.description: Will Croatia change their tactical formation during the match?
markets.expert_reasoning: Too ambiguous — formation changes are subjective judgement calls. Low fun. High exploit risk from tactical insiders.

markets.description: Will there be 4 or more yellow cards shown in the match?
markets.expert_reasoning: Clear settlement. Interesting market. Standard discipline market with manageable risk.
